title: Early Intervention Assistant
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Develop strategies that promote partnerships between teachers, families, programs, and their communities
integrate an understanding of the needs, multiple influences and characteristics on the development of children birth to eight as related to high quality education and care
apply effective interaction strategies and guidance that will support all children’s self-confidence, self-esteem, and social learning, identity
design, implement, and evaluate activities and environments that support positive developmental play and learning outcomes for infants, toddlers, and children.

notes: The section's only total is the heading 'Required Core Courses:(18 units)'. This block is the certificate's only requirement, so 18 is also recorded as total_units. The page prints no separate certificate-total sentence; a reviewer should confirm this reading.
Program Learning Outcomes are printed as a single paragraph with semicolons between items. They were split at the semicolons into four outcomes, keeping the printed wording and the final period.

The description names California Child Development Permit levels (Assistant Teacher, Associate Teacher, Teacher, Master Teacher, Site Supervisor). These were treated as permit titles rather than careers named for the program, so careers is empty; a reviewer should check this.
The catalog prints CDEV C1000; it was matched to the closed-list entry CDEVC1000.
The section is marked 'Effective Summer 2022' within the 2026-2027 catalog.
